original_rule: Derive the first128 HMAC-SHA256 bits for both channels.
fixed_channel_rule: Use the most significant64 bits of the already-derived128-bit fixed channel value: fixed_seed = derived128 >> 64.
portable_channel_rule: Keep the preregistered128-bit portable seed unchanged.
justification: Accepted live fixed-sensor interface requires unsigned64-bit seeds. No fixed sensor stochastic error is configured in this study: declared noise, bias, quantization and dropout are zero. There is no resampling or draw-based selection.
unchanged: all observation timing and deterministic fixed-error laws
